verdict.rationale: None of the evidence discusses configuring multiple pay schedules (weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, monthly) or assigning different schedules to different teams; the pack covers payroll accuracy checks, fringe benefits recording, PTO policies, Xero integration mapping, and onboarding — none address pay frequency setup. Missing for 10: any documentation of pay schedule configuration, frequency options, or per-team/department schedule assignment.
